title: Rioproperty deals
description: A big capital heading and a small arrow link over a sideways-scrolling track of tall photo cards at loose, uneven heights, running off the right edge; each card has its type and status in grey capitals under the photo. The track drifts up as you scroll. On hover the photo turns grey under a dark veil, a paper corner tab with an arrow folds in at the top right, and the details rise from below: district and size, the name in big wide capitals, and a violet bar with the type and status in yellow.
notes: each media slot fills its card like object-fit cover; empty, it is a bg-muted placeholder
the track is a native sideways scroller with snap (swipe, trackpad or shift-wheel)
the hover bar uses primary with highlight text
